text: Bicep never replaced ARM — it compiles to it. Every Bicep resource this chapter used is, underneath, an ARM template resource.

az bicep build turns a .bicep file into the exact ARM JSON it would deploy as anyway. az bicep decompile goes the other way, converting an existing ARM template into Bicep, and matters more in practice.
Almost nobody hand-writes new ARM JSON today. It still surfaces from a Portal template export, some older tooling, or a newer resource type where provider support hasn't caught up yet.
Bicep syntax and resource blocks, parameters and the Problems pane, the deploy command with a dry run, a real server-and-database pair with a secured password, and now the ARM JSON underneath it all.
Chapter 3 is complete. Next up: Chapter 4, IaC in Practice.
